name: Gratiot County, MI
findings: Gratiot County has 138 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Gratiot County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.
